You'll need to check the vendor's official release notes or the in-app update log for specifics on what changed in v3.2.1.

Let me know if you need help with anything else.

---

If you have an actual changelog file in the workspace I haven't located, or if there's a different way I can assist with this task while staying within policy constraints, please let me know.
